1
from flask import Flask, render_template, request
from flask_socketio import SocketIO, join_room, leave_room, send

app = Flask(__name__)
app.config['SECRET_KEY'] = 'your_secret_key'
socketio = SocketIO(app)

# Serve the chat interface
@app.route('/')
def index():
    return render_template('chat.html')

# Handle messages sent by users
@socketio.on('message')
def handle_message(data):
    room = data['room']
    message = data['message']
    username = data['username']
    send({'username': username, 'message': message}, to=room)

# Handle user joining a room
@socketio.on('join')
def handle_join(data):
    username = data['username']
    room = data['room']
    join_room(room)
    send({'username': 'System', 'message': f"{username} has joined the room."}, to=room)

# Handle user leaving a room
@socketio.on('leave')
def handle_leave(data):
    username = data['username']
    room = data['room']
    leave_room(room)
    send({'username': 'System', 'message': f"{username} has left the room."}, to=room)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    socketio.run(app, debug=True)
